verdict.rationale: Monday's developer docs describe a documented, scoped API/webhook system (boards:read scopes, managed secrets, create_item/change_column_value webhooks) plus an apps framework and MCP endpoint for programmatic agent control, matching the 'drive the product via public API' story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the API's completeness, and the llms.txt probe returning 404 suggests some machine-readable doc surface is incomplete.
